Interface TransactionView

All Superinterfaces:
BaseView
All Known Implementing Classes:
SwingStoreView
public interface TransactionView extends BaseView
View interface for transaction management and sales reporting operations. Extends BaseView to provide transaction-specific user interactions including transaction viewing, receipt display, and sales analytics.

  • Method Details

    • displayTransactionMenu

      void displayTransactionMenu()
      Displays the transaction management menu to the user. Typically includes options for viewing transactions, generating receipts, and accessing sales reports and analytics.

    • getTransactionMenuChoice

      int getTransactionMenuChoice()
      Gets the user's selection from the transaction management menu.
      Returns:
      the user's menu choice as an integer

    • displayTransactions

      void displayTransactions(List<TransactionDTO> transactions)
      Displays a list of transactions to the user. Shows transaction information in a list format, typically with summary details for each transaction.
      Parameters:
      transactions - the list of TransactionDTO objects to display

    • displayTransaction

      void displayTransaction(TransactionDTO transaction)
      Displays detailed information for a single transaction. Shows comprehensive transaction details including customer information, items purchased, financial breakdown, and loyalty points.
      Parameters:
      transaction - the TransactionDTO containing detailed transaction information to display

    • displayReceipt

      void displayReceipt(String receipt)
      Displays a formatted receipt for a transaction. Shows a professionally formatted receipt suitable for printing or customer presentation.
      Parameters:
      receipt - the formatted receipt string to display

    • displayTotalSales

      void displayTotalSales(double totalSales)
      Displays the total sales amount across all transactions.
      Parameters:
      totalSales - the total sales amount to display

    • displayTotalSalesByDate

      void displayTotalSalesByDate(LocalDate date, double totalSales)
      Displays the total sales amount for a specific date.
      Parameters:
      date - the date for which sales are being displayed
      totalSales - the total sales amount for the specified date

    • displayTotalSalesByDateRange

      void displayTotalSalesByDateRange(LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate, double totalSales)
      Displays the total sales amount within a specified date range.
      Parameters:
      startDate - the start date of the sales period
      endDate - the end date of the sales period
      totalSales - the total sales amount for the specified date range
